name: Spear Rise
description: Raise the soul spear from a low guard and thrust it up under the target's chin of will.

name: Haft Brace
description: Plant the spear haft against the ground of the soul and take a hostile push on its length.

name: Spear Taste
description: Touch the spear head to a soul and taste its strength and temper from the way it bites.

name: Counter Haft
description: Beat a thrust of soul force aside with the spear haft and bring the head round to threaten.

name: Staggering Spear
description: Drive the spear into the target's guard so hard their stance buckles and their next move stumbles.

name: Reaving Lunge
description: Lunge the spear head through the target's will and rip a ragged hole in their composure.

name: Spear Unmaking
description: Thrust a spear of dense soul force through every layer of a guard and undo the will it shelters.

name: Rain of Points
description: Split the spear into a hundred points and let them fall across every mind within the user's reach.

name: Ripple Rap
description: Send a small ripple of soul force out and let it rap against the target's will with a growing knock.

name: Swell Screen
description: Raise a rounded swell of will before the mind that rolls an incoming soul wave up and over.

name: Wave Measure
description: Send out a gentle wave and gauge the size and depth of each soul from the way it returns.

name: Rising Swell
description: Let the will rise in slow swells so that each wave sent afterward arrives heavier than the last.

name: Leaning Wave
description: Press a slow wave of soul force against the target until their will bows under the weight.

name: Cresting Blow
description: Time the strike to the crest of a wave so the force lands at its heaviest on one foe.

name: Trough Pull
description: Draw the target's will down into the hollow after a wave so their guard drops just as the next arrives.

name: Breaking Surge
description: Let the whole stored wave break at once and crash across every soul in front of the user.

name: Drowning Press
description: Bear down on one target with wave after wave until their will goes under and stops answering.

name: Seam Feeler
description: Slide a thin probe along a soul to feel for the stitching where its parts are joined.

name: Seam Nick
description: Nick one stitch of the target's will with a flick of force and watch the line begin to loosen.

name: Closing Seam
description: Pull the user's own stitching tight so a probing edge finds no loose thread to catch on.

name: Strand Pluck
description: Pluck at a loosened thread so the target's focus twangs and their technique comes out off pitch.

name: Seam Pry
description: Wedge force into a found seam and lever it open so the guard parts along its own joint.

name: Unstitching
description: Pull stitch after stitch from the target's will until their techniques no longer hold together.

name: Seam Sunder
description: Split the soul clean along its strongest seam in one stroke so the will falls open in two halves.

name: Full Unseaming
description: Unpick every seam in a foe's soul over several breaths until they can no longer gather their will at all.

name: Paired Pricks
description: Prick the target twice at once with a matched pair of needles set a hand's width apart.

name: Twinned Screen
description: Hold two thin screens of will one behind the other so a probe that passes the first meets the second.

name: Mirror Measure
description: Send one needle to the foe and keep one at the user and compare how each answers.

name: Second Needle
description: Hold a second needle ready at the user's shoulder so the next strike may follow at once.

name: Matched Jabs
description: Jab with both needles in step so that each lands on the mark the other has just opened.

name: Crossing Needles
description: Cross the two needles in front of the target's focus and snip the thread of their technique.

name: Twin Pin
description: Pin the target's will between the two needles so neither arm of their technique can move.

name: Echoed Prick
description: Follow the first needle with a second down the same wound so the pain lands twice as deep.

name: Doubled Sunder
description: Drive both needles into the same point at once and split the target's guard clean through.

name: Twin Thread Piercing
description: Draw one needle after the other through the same opening so the second thread passes where the first has cut.

name: Raptor Sight
description: Lift the sense high above the fight and mark every soul below with a hawk's sharp attention.

name: Plummet Strike
description: Fall on the target's will from above in a steep fast dive of soul force.

name: Mantle Ward
description: Spread the soul like a mantle of feathers to take a blow across its whole breadth.

name: Talon Flick
description: Flick a talon of force across the target's focus and tear a strip from their concentration.

name: Claw Hook
description: Hook the talon into the target's will and hold fast so they cannot twist away from the next stroke.

name: Diving Cut
description: Dive with the edge foremost and cut through the outer guard in a single falling line.

name: Hawk Descent
description: Fall from a great height of will on one mark and strike so hard the guard gives way.

name: Pair Plunge
description: Dive twice in the same breath so the second stroke lands in the hole the first has torn.

name: Slow Fill
description: Fill the hollow of the will slowly like a basin and let the stored force settle until it is ready.

name: Rivulet Strike
description: Let a thin rivulet of soul force run out of the basin and strike a single mark.

name: Turbid Ward
description: Cloud the water of the will with silt so that a seeking soul strike loses its way.

name: Current Read
description: Feel the flow of force through a foe's soul and learn which way their will is running.

name: Eddy Pull
description: Spin a small eddy in the target's focus until their attention circles and cannot settle on the fight.

name: Undertow Grip
description: Drag at the target's will from below so it is pulled off its footing and held there.

name: Brimming Strike
description: Strike with the basin full to its lip so the blow carries all the force that was gathered.

name: Overflow
description: Let the basin spill over in a broad sheet of force that sweeps every mind before the user.

name: Drowned Mind
description: Flood one target's soul until their thoughts sink under the weight and no action can rise.

name: Sworn Cut
description: Speak the vow inwardly and cut the target's will with an edge held true to the word.

name: Pledge Screen
description: Set the vow between the user and the blow so that the pledge itself holds the line.

name: Pledge Measure
description: Test a foe's soul for the weight of what it has promised and what it holds back.

name: Held Vow
description: Hold the vow steady in the will so each cut afterward keeps its edge through a long fight.

name: Spoken Nick
description: Breathe one word of the vow as the edge falls and leave a small clean nick in the target's resolve.

name: Tying Word
description: Lay the force of a given word on the target's will so it cannot raise an arm against the oath.

name: Forsworn Slash
description: Slash at the place in a foe's soul where their own pledge sits weakest and cut the pledge through.

name: Vow Rending
description: Tear through the vow a foe has made to themselves and spoil the technique that stood on it.

name: Oath Reckoning
description: Call every unkept promise in a foe's soul to account at once and bow their will beneath the debt.

name: Wind-Sworn Cut
description: Swear the edge to the wind and loose one cut so fast and straight that no guard turns it.

name: Bearing Take
description: Fix the heading of a foe's soul from where it stands and where its will leans.

name: Steady Heading
description: Hold the line of the will on its bearing so that the aim of every stroke stays true.

name: Crosswind Turn
description: Turn the soul a quarter round as a blow arrives so the force slides off along the wind.

name: True Thrust
description: Send the force along a perfectly straight line to its mark without waver or spread.

name: Steadfast Heading
description: Keep a line of force fixed on the target so their will cannot swing free of it.

name: Drawn Bolt
description: Draw a single line of force through the target's guard from the user to the centre of their will.

name: Tether Lock
description: Lock the target's will onto the line of force so every move they make draws them back onto it.

name: Distant Bolt
description: Gather force along the bearing over several breaths and loose it at a distant foe in one unbroken stroke.

name: Open Sense
description: Leave the mind open to the air and feel every soul that moves across it like a change in the wind.

name: Unclad Strike
description: Strike with no cloak or guard on the force so it flies bare and fast to its mark.

name: Gust Turn
description: Let the mind bend like grass so a hard soul blow passes through without catching.

name: Loose Rein
description: Let the will run on a loose rein so the force gathers speed without the strain of holding it.

name: Scouring Gust
description: Send a dry gust of soul force over the field to scour the calm from every mind it crosses.

name: Stripping Draft
description: Draw a steady draft through the target's will to carry off their guard layer by layer.

name: Whistle Wind
description: Pour a hollow whistling wind into the target's mind until they cannot hear their own thoughts.

name: Unwalled Rush
description: Rush forward with the mind wide open and let the full wind of the soul break over one foe.

name: Wind Reckoning
description: Gather a great wind of will over several breaths and loose it to strip every guard in front of the user.
